notes: Colour wash for photo layers: push a picture into a team colour while keeping the photograph - every highlight, shadow and edge survives, only the colour changes. It is the two-tone look used for a head-to-head, and the colour can come from a spreadsheet column so one design carries a different team on every row. Also: rotation you can type. Layers could always be turned with the handle on the canvas; there is now a slider and a number box under Position and size, because a row of angled panels only looks deliberate when every one sits on exactly the same angle.
